title: bolbitis subcordata
intro: Bolbitis subcordata, commonly known as the "fern of the gods," is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae, which is a type of aquatic fern. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, headache, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits.
